# GitHub configuration

## GitHub Actions — disabled

This project intentionally does **not** use GitHub Actions.

- Do not add workflow files under `.github/workflows/`.
- CI, deploy, lint, and test automation are run locally (Composer, Pest, npm/Vite) as documented in `docs/TESTING.md` and `docs/DEPLOYMENT.md`.
- If this repository is hosted on GitHub, keep Actions disabled in repository settings as well.
